from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document found in the collection."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific identifier or title of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseRecord]
